title: Kissed, Light Greek Pork Back Ribs Grill
description: A malty, light, and cozy Greek dish featuring pork back ribs, grilled to perfection with a hint of Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 275°F (135°C) and remove the pork back ribs from the refrigerator.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, honey, garlic powder, dried oregano, and kosher salt.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the pork back ribs.
Place the pork back ribs on the grill, bone-side down, and cook for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, brush the ribs with the remaining marinade and continue cooking for another 30 minutes.
Rotate the ribs 90 degrees to achieve those beautiful grill marks.
Remove the ribs from the grill and let them rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork back ribs into individual portions and serve with pita bread and a side salad, if desired.
